name: Eden
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Eden, NC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Eden, North Carolina for 2026: WinterFEST, two parades and a Santa party, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Eden fills the first weeks of December with a park festival, two parades and a Santa party in Rockingham County.
celebrates: The City of Eden hosts WinterFEST at Grogan Park on December 4, with an outdoor movie, games, s'mores and hot chocolate. Draper holds its Children's Christmas Parade on December 5, and the RoCo Is Home Foundation presents the Olde Leaksville Nighttime Christmas Parade in uptown Eden on December 12. Mulligans Social adds a Kids Christmas Party with Santa on November 28.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Eden's holiday events, so this page leans on the City of Eden and Visit Rockingham County listings for 2026. The Draper listing numbers its parade the 59th annual, which shows it is a long running tradition.
facts: Eden is in Rockingham County, and Draper, the home of the children's parade, lists its parade on Fieldcrest Road in Eden. The Olde Leaksville parade is listed at 622 Washington St in Downtown and Uptown Eden by the Visit Rockingham County calendar.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride in Eden for 2026. For a train day trip, the N.C. Transportation Museum in Spencer is listed on our museum guide.
train_links: A railroad museum in Spencer, listed on our museum guide.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Eden for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Kids Christmas Party with Santa at Mulligans Social) through December 12 (Olde Leaksville Nighttime Christmas Parade), with WinterFEST at Grogan Park (December 4) and the Draper Children's Christmas Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Eden

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Eden
  • 3 free events: WinterFEST at Grogan Park, the Draper Children's Christmas Parade and the Olde Leaksville Nighttime Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Kids Christmas Party with Santa at Mulligans Social (November 28)
  • Parades and festivals: Draper Children's Parade (December 5), Olde Leaksville Nighttime Parade (December 12) and WinterFEST (December 4)
  • Season: November 28 to December 12
